entities.summary: Jan Boye was a Danish politician, representing the Conservative Party. From 1 January 2006 to 31 December 2009, he was mayor of Odense, Denmark's third largest city. He served as County Mayor of Funen County from 2001 to 2005. He also served as the chairman of Dansk Håndbold Forbund from June 2011 to his death.
